text:
mina_eval: Bringing up phoenix-v2 q4f16 on staging — running multilingual smoke. Seen two weird things: 1) zh-CN outputs cut off mid-character in a few long prompts (looks like subtoken dropout). 2) ar-SA outputs reorder punctuation/quotes (RTL punctuation moving to wrong side). Anyone seen this?
sam_engineer: hmm, do you have a minimal repro? samples?
mina_eval: pasted a few in staging logs: ```PROMPT: 请翻译：这是一个测试。EXPECTED: 这是一个测试。ACTUAL: 这是一个```
mina_eval: another: long paragraph with names, output truncates with half of the last hanzi dropped.
yujin: could be kv-cache alignment when sequence length crosses a kernel boundary in q4 path. we've seen off-by-one before on mixed-byte sequences.
tony_infra: rolling log: gpu0 driver shows a few kernel warnings during that batch window, attaching snippet: ```WARN: kernel exec truncated at seq=1024 for model phoenix-v2-q4f16 batch=8``` 
mina_eval: thanks — also attaching Arabic example: ```PROMPT: «هل يمكنك مساعدتي؟» EXPECTED: «هل يمكنك مساعدتي؟» ACTUAL: ؟\"هل يمكنك مساعدتي«```
sara_ml: that Arabic looks like punctuation/wrong bidi embedding markers. Could be our detokenizer reorder after quantized decoder emits different softmax peaks for leading punctuation.
kenji_localization: I can repro in local docker with q4f16 binary. Repro steps: ```docker run --rm -v $PWD:/data phoenix-v2:q4f16 ./infer --prompt \"長いテキスト...\" --max-tokens 600``` — truncation consistently at 512->513 boundary.
sam_engineer: can you try staging with q8 or fp16 to confirm it's quant path-only?
mina_eval: q8 run looks clean — no truncation, Arabic fine. So likely q4f16 specific.
tony_infra: schedule: I'll trigger a bisect build across quant kernels tomorrow and run the failing prompts across different kernel versions. tagging @sara_ml for eval set.
deploybot: canary deployed phoenix-v2-q4f16 -> staging at 2755550120
sara_ml: I'll generate a focused eval: 200 CJK longform cases, 50 Arabic/RTL punctuation cases, include mixed LTR tokens (quotes, «», „, “). Will attach results here.
yujin: quick mitigation: add a post-detok pass that validates grapheme completeness and re-runs KV alignment if mismatch detected. Not ideal but buys time.
mina_eval: agreed — patch looks good. thanks everyone. I'll add failing samples to phoenix onboarding ticket.
sam_engineer: noted. follow-up: add unit test for seq-length boundary with multibyte tokens and rtl punctuation. :thumbsup:
mina_eval: closing loop: added ticket #INFER-1429 with samples + logs.
